title: Workspace actor Project membership facts
$comment: Fixed raw Workspace membership facts for a caller-owned actor ID. Authorization and Identity account checks remain with the caller.

functions.semantics: Return each raw ProjectMember project ID and role text for p_user_id, including legacy or unknown role values, without ordering or account/project joins. The caller retains Identity activity, platform-role, project-role, viewer-pairing and requested-role checks. SQL NULL returns no rows because the function is STRICT, matching an equality predicate against the original NOT NULL user_id column. No row locks, writes, or transaction ownership are added.
